# Source Fact Checking

## When to use
Use when the task requires independently verify externally checkable claims and payment/platform evidence against dated primary sources.

## Procedure
Extract individual claims; test each with authoritative primary sources wherever possible; record evidence age, contradiction, confidence, and unsupported items. Severe unknowns yield NEEDS_EVIDENCE, not PASS. Return actionable corrections to proposer.

## Mandatory handoff
Return: input/assumptions, steps completed, dated evidence or local record IDs, confidence, blockers, quality checks, next action. If required evidence or permission is missing, stop and mark UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED rather than guessing.

## Safety
No financial commitment, account registration, external outreach, false identity, geographic restriction bypass, or publication without explicit user approval. Avoid leaking credentials or private data.
